scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && pnpm -r --parallel typecheck
scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ant/mobile exec cap sync
scripts.mobile:ios: pnpm mobile:sync && pnpm --filter @ant/mobile exec cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: pnpm mobile:sync && pnpm --filter @ant/mobile exec cap open android
